v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
text.en: While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

text.la: In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.
text.en: We will run after thee, * in the savour of thy good ointments. The virgins love them exceedingly.

text.la: Iam hiems tránsiit, * imber ábiit et recéssit: surge, amíca mea, et veni.
text.en: Lo the winter is past, * the rain is over and gone. Rise up, my love, and come away.

text.la: Veni, elécta mea, * et ponam in te thronum meum, allelúia.
text.en: Come, O My chosen one, * and I will establish My throne in thee. Alleluia.

text.la: Ista est speciósa * inter fílias Ierúsalem.
text.en: She is beautiful * among the daughters of Jerusalem.

text.la: Mulíerem fortem quis invéniet? Procul et de últimis fínibus prétium eius. Confídit in ea cor viri sui, et spóliis non indigébit.
text.en: Who shall find a valiant woman? Far and from the uttermost coasts is the price of her. The heart of her husband trusteth in her, and he shall have no need of spoils.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Manum suam * apéruit ínopi, et palmas suas exténdit ad páuperem, et panem otiósa non comédit.
text.en: She spreadeth out her hand to the poor, * yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

text.la: Deus, qui beátæ Annæ grátiam conférre dignátus es, ut Genetrícis unigéniti Fílii tui mater éffici mererétur: concéde propítius; ut, cuius solémnia celebrámus, eius apud te patrocíniis adiuvémur.
text.en: O God, Who in thy kindness gave blessed Anne the grace to be the mother of her who mothered thy only-begotten Son, graciously grant that we who keep her feast may be helped by her intercession with thee.
